rawContent: Reliable sources say that the #MeToo plaintiff in the Minnesota case is seriously considering running for Congress as an independent candidate. We need to fix some laws in this Country.

What a waste of public funds. Meanwhile I've learned from a reliable source that a #MeToo victim and plaintiff in a separate lawsuit against the University of Minnesota is considering a run for U.S. Congress as an independent candidate. People are fed up!

@forwardpartymn @Fwd_Party @AndrewYang A #Metoo victim may seek the Forward Party endorsement for Congress in #MN02.
